audit_items.proof_trace: The property is an assumption type and cannot be enforced on-chain without a second independent oracle. The code implements all available protections: (1) Pyth confidence interval check (`assert_price_conf_within_range`, pyth_adaptor.move:91-96) ensures price reporters agree to within the configured bps threshold; (2) tiered freshness enforcement — ≤30s at Pyth ingestion and ≤5s at XOracle read-time (`check_price`, user.move:61-69); (3) EMA-spot deviation guard (`get_price_with_check`, user.move:42-59) aborts transactions when spot and EMA diverge beyond the per-asset tolerance (default 10%); (4) registered feed-ID pinning (`assert_pyth_price_info_object`, x_oracle.move:122) prevents adversarial feed substitution. All non-liquidation borrow and collateral valuation paths use `get_price_with_check` (not the unchecked `get_price`), and the returned EMA price is more manipulation-resistant than spot.
